title: Write its objective, and file what needs doing
objective:
Do: write the objective: a few plain lines on what the project is. What you found that needs doing (a broken build, a missing deploy) is an open item of the Workspace, one per thing.
Details: `workspace objective <handle> -` with the text on stdin (`workspace --help`); each item `item create --title "<short name>: <detail>" --workspace <handle>`.
Check: `workspace list` shows the objective under the handle.
